description: Header file defining data structures and functions for sparse block matrix operations in QNNPACK, including BCSRMatrix classes, generation functions, and dispatch macros.

classes.name: OwnedOrBorrowedVector
classes.description: Template struct managing either owned or borrowed vector data, with methods for access and size.

classes.name: BCSRMatrix
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a Block Compressed Sparse Row matrix with virtual methods for data access, unpacking, and max index.

classes.name: TypedBCSRMatrix
classes.description: Template class derived from BCSRMatrix, implementing specific storage for indices and data, with methods for data access, printing, unpacking, and max index.

methods.name: OwnedOrBorrowedVector
methods.description: Constructor and data access methods for managing vector data ownership or borrowing.

methods.name: BCSRMatrix
methods.description: Virtual destructor and interface for BCSR matrix operations.

methods.name: TypedBCSRMatrix
methods.description: Constructor, data access, print, unpack, and max_index methods for typed BCSR matrices.

methods.name: generateBlockCSRMatrix
methods.description: Functions to generate BCSR matrices from raw data or pointers, with support for different index data types.
